title: Closeout summary: Define typed EnforcementGap contract with stable gap codes
body:
Subject: work:bw_work_d6b0cf8944a3b729
Status: verified
Priority: high

## Outcome

WHY: the refactor thesis is directives as projections of enforcement, which requires enforcement to speak a stable typed vocabulary. Today the closest thing is CloseoutGateGap (packages/engine/src/runtime.ts lines 176-183) with free-text reason strings, plus BorealError details with inconsistent shapes. WHAT: design and land the EnforcementGap type in @boreal/core - a stable machine code (for example gate.verification.unsatisfied, work.blocked.open-dependency, reservation.not-ready, close.no-passing-verification, summary.missing), subjectId and subjectType, optional targetId, and a typed data payload sized to what the eventual directive needs (blocker ids, gate ids, required evidence kinds, min counts, declared commands). Write the enumeration of codes as a checked-in constant the registry inversion (sprint 3) will key against. Include a JSON schema under schemas/ mirroring the type, and an ADR-style note in docs/decisions recording the naming scheme, since gap codes become a public contract once directives key off them. Do not wire emission yet; that is the next task.

- bw_evidence_1be7a57a5b67c9bc: passed Defined the typed EnforcementGap contract, stable code set, JSON schema, and decision note in checkpoint ffa6c80a; pnpm check and runtime tests passed.
